title: refactor(app-shell): move ObjectView's list toolbar affordances into a sibling hook (slice 7)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VtKf3F9dzJPJM4RRtABaEc)_

Part of #25992 (slice 7 of the move-only split; slices 1 to 6 landed as #26152, #26233, #26310, #26336 and #26353, and the card stays open for the slices listed below).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `3db7bbfc` (slices 5+6 merged). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` is 2926 lines there. Concern **D** of the seam table, the list toolbar's affordances, moves verbatim into the custom hook `useObjectViewToolbarAffordances` in a new sibling module `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewToolbarAffordances.ts`. It moves in two blocks:

- lines 503–534: the environment list's entitlements (`isEnvironmentList`, `useEnvironmentEntitlements`), the read gate on the object's list actions (`listActionsReadable`, `listActions`), and `localizedToolbarActions`,
- lines 563–682: the create predicates (`objectCanCreate`, `createVisible`, `createDisabled`), `listAddRecordOpensCreate`, `pageOffersCreate` with the capability gate and predicate scope it reads, and the import predicates (`objectCanImport`, `importVisible`, `importDisabled`), with every docblock.

The hook is called as `useObjectViewToolbarAffordances({ objectDef, dataSource, actionRuntime, refreshKey, perms, localizeActionTexts, newVerdict, importVerdict })`. It returns the twelve names the rest of the component reads, and the component destructures them under their original names. No identifier is renamed and no context is added. The parameters are typed from their sources, with no `any`: `ConsoleObjectViewProps['objects'][number]`, `DataSource`, `Pick<ConsoleActionRuntime, 'authFetch'>`, `ReturnType<typeof usePermissions>`, `ReturnType<typeof useActionTextLocalizer>`, and `ReturnType<typeof resolveAffordance>` for both verdicts.

**What stays.** The verdict memo between the two blocks (lines 536–557: `newVerdict` and `importVerdict` from `resolveAffordance('listNew' | 'listImport', …)`) stays in the component and is passed in. `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` keys the `listImport` row's reader by file: the write site `ImportWizard > legacyImport :: create` names `ObjectView.tsx` as a file that reads `listImport`, and every file it names must read one of its rows. Keeping the `resolveAffordance` call here keeps that census green with no test edit. The three-line comment on `refreshKey` after the memo stays too.

**Hook order.** The hook is called right after the verdict memo, so the first block's hooks (`useEnvironmentEntitlements`, the `localizedToolbarActions` memo) now run after that memo instead of before it. They share no value with it, the order is the same on every render, and no effect sits between them, so the effects' order is unchanged.

**Imports.** Each import moves with its only readers: `useRowPredicate`, `useCapabilityGate`, `usePredicateScope`, `RowCrudPredicates`, `listToolbarDrawsAction`, `mayReadObject` and `useEnvironmentEntitlements`. Nothing new is exported from `ObjectView.tsx`, and the package entry is untouched. `ObjectView.tsx` goes from 2926 to 2797 lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectView.tsx` is contained in new `ObjectView.tsx` plus `objectViewToolbarAffordances.ts`. The only base lines missing are the two import lines that lost a moved name (`managedByEmptyState.js`, `@object-ui/react`), each replaced by its trimmed form. The added lines are the trimmed imports and the new import, the module header and imports, the hook signature and parameter types, the `return` object, and in `ObjectView.tsx` the call with its destructuring and two-line comment.

## Test edits

None. `affordanceGrantMap-12082` is covered by keeping the verdict memo in place (above). No other source reader of `ObjectView.tsx` names a moved line.

## Seam table rows this PR changes (measured on `3db7bbfc`)

The full table (regions A to Q) is in #26336.

| # | Concern | Lines on `3db7bbfc` | Reads | Read by | Slice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D | Environment entitlements, list actions, create and import toolbar predicates | 503–534, 563–682 | A (`localizeActionTexts`), C (`objectDef`, `perms`, `refreshKey`, `actionRuntime`), D-verdicts, prop `dataSource` | G, O, P, Q | **7, this PR** |
| D-verdicts | `resolveAffordance` verdicts for `listNew` and `listImport` | 536–557 | C (`objectDef`, `perms`) | D | stays (grant census reads it in this file) |

## Remaining slices (the last closes the card)

- **Slice 8 — G + H + L-filter:** header toolbar actions, the list URL state and the URL/user filter block into sibling hooks; re-points `ObjectView.urlFilterSuffix-9196.test.ts` to the new file as a path-only edit if L-filter moves.
- **Slice 9 — N + P:** the view tab bar and the plugin schema plus header chrome.
- **Slice 10 — Q:** the JSX return's `PageHeader`, import wizard and `NavigationOverlay` blocks into sub-components with explicit props.
- **Slice 11 — B + I + O (closes the card):** the view-config and view-tab CRUD handlers and `renderListView`, with the `writeRefusalCensus-11583` rows and the `relayRungCensus-7559` read re-pointed (path and file-key changes only).

## Verification

See the os-dev-report comment on the card for the full readings: app-shell `type-check` after rebuilding its dependency closure, every `ObjectView.*` test in `views/`, the `AppContent*` tests, every other test that reads `ObjectView.tsx` as source, the app-shell tests that touch environment entitlements, the managed-by empty state, the object read gate or the CRUD affordances, eslint on the 2 touched files, the derived dispatch gates, and a Console build.

## Acceptance notes

- eslint: 0 errors, and no new warning. The two files report 131 warnings, the same count as the base `ObjectView.tsx` alone; the two in the new module are casts moved verbatim (`(import.meta as any).env`, the `(a: any)` map callback).

Changeset: `.changeset/25992-objectview-toolbar-affordances-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).
